name: Jack-o-Lantern
note: Jack-o'-lantern: Shade the rib grooves and the right side of the pumpkin with deep red-brown, keeping a broad sheen on the left ribs. Make the purple sunburst slightly lighter and less saturated.

name: Witch Hat
note: Witch Hat: Paint the hat in deep plum-purple felt with violet shadows instead of black, with a soft lighter sheen down the left of the cone. Make the green rings slightly softer and lighter, with no bright yellow-green core behind the brim.

name: Bat
note: Bat: Change the sunburst to cool violet-purple rays. Paint the wing membranes dusky violet-brown and draw the body fur as a few soft rounded clumps instead of strands.

name: Candlestick
note: Candlestick: Replace the grey speckled stone counter with a smooth warm honey-wood ledge. Let the flame cast a small warm glow on the candle top and the inside of the dish. Put the right side of the brass stem in clear shadow.

name: Cauldron
note: Cauldron: Paint the pot dark blue-violet iron with a lit rim and a broad soft highlight on the upper left of the belly instead of solid black, with no scratches. Remove the daisies. Make the pink rings an even, slightly dustier rose with no bright spot behind the pot.

name: Candy Corn
note: Candy Corn: Light from the upper right so the left side of the candy is clearly darker, matching its cast shadow. Make the tip a warm waxy cream. Darken the wall stripes slightly so the tip is the brightest spot.

name: Haunted House
note: Haunted House: Remove the moon and the daisies. Paint the stone walls a warm lilac and the roofs deep plum, with the side wall and the right of the tower slightly darker. Make the sky and grass slightly softer and less saturated.

name: Spooky Tree
note: Spooky Tree: Remove the falling orange leaf. Light from the upper left so the right side of the trunk is slightly darker, and add a soft tree shadow on the grass to the right.

name: Ghost Sheep
note: Ghost Sheep: Remove the jack-o'-lantern and the motion lines; the sheep stands alone on the lawn. Make the sky a calm daytime blue with only a hint of lavender. Shade the sheet folds in soft blue-grey, slightly lighter.

name: Jack-o'-Lantern
note: Cargo Barrel (pumpkin): Make the table smooth warm-brown planks with a few soft grain lines and no peeling paint, scratches or nail heads. Make the blue sky even, with no glow behind the pumpkin. Keep the pumpkin as is.

name: Witch Hat
note: Witch Hat: Make the hat a deep plum-purple felt instead of black, with soft violet lit faces on the crown and brim and rich indigo shadows. Make the background rays a slightly deeper teal. Keep the hat shape and band.

name: Cauldron
note: Cooler Box (cauldron): Make the pot a dark blue-grey iron with a lit rim and a lighter left side instead of solid black, and let the fire cast warm orange light onto its underside and legs. Make the wall and floor a slightly brighter lavender with fewer cracks. Keep the scene otherwise.

name: Crystal Ball
note: Vending (crystal ball): Remove the bright glow behind the ball and keep the green rings tone-on-tone. Replace the hard white window highlight with a small soft highlight at the upper left and slightly darken the right side of the glass. Keep the stand as is.

name: Haunted Door
note: Haunted Door: Light from the upper left so the arch stones cast soft shadows down onto the wooden planks and the right side of each stone is darker. Make the stone wall a slightly richer lavender-blue instead of grey. Keep the door as is.

name: Spooky Tree
note: Spooky Tree: Replace the castle tower with soft distant bushes. Light from the upper left so the right side of the trunk and roots is slightly darker, and add a soft tree shadow on the grass to the right. Keep the tree as is.

name: Potion
note: Treasure (potion): Make the tabletop smooth, clean warm-brown planks with no moss, grime or nail heads. Make the pink background even, with no pale glow behind the bottle. Keep the bottle and its green glow.

name: Boo Surprise
note: Selfie: Remove the pumpkin and the ivy leaves. Paint the door and porch boards in smooth, clean colors with no peeling paint or grain scratches. Light the whole porch evenly so the corners are not darkened.

name: Robot
note: Replace the riveted steel floor plates with a plain warm wooden ledge, and keep the striped yellow wall. Make the robot's white slightly cooler, with light blue-grey shadows on its right sides.

name: Space Helmet
note: Make the helmet shell a slightly cooler, clean white with light blue-grey shadows. Make the visor a deep smoky blue glass with one warm reflection.

name: Alien Pet
note: Replace the riveted metal floor with a plain wooden desk top or a soft gradient floor. Make the pink backdrop slightly more muted, and make the right side of the alien slightly darker.

name: Moon Rover
note: Paint the rover body bright orange with white trim. Smooth the ground into soft grey-beige dust with two or three large soft craters and no scattered pebbles or rocks.

name: Control Panel
note: Paint the console body a saturated teal-blue metal and keep the red buttons. Replace the glossy steel shelf with a plain soft floor and a gentle reflection, on the orange-yellow gradient.

name: Robot
note: Shade the robot's right side slightly cooler blue-grey; make the stripes a slightly deeper golden orange; matte wooden ledge without the glossy reflection.

name: Space Helmet
note: Slightly cooler white helmet shell with light blue-grey shading on the right side; visor slightly darker amber-gold than the background.

name: Alien Pet
note: One plain smooth cool-grey floor without plate seams or rivets; even warm pink backdrop with no spotlight or dark corners.

name: Moon Rover
note: Replace the cloudy sky with a smooth deep-blue space gradient; cool blue-grey ground with two or three large shallow craters; smooth orange deck without screws.

name: Control Panel
note: Soft contact shadow on a matte floor in place of the mirror reflection; satin teal finish instead of hard white edge highlights; no corner screws.

name: Rocket
note: Rocket: Replace the concrete floor with a smooth painted floor in soft cool blue, with no grit or seams. Give the white body a soft glossy sheen, lit from the upper left so its right side is slightly cooler and darker. Keep the orange-yellow stripes.

name: Flying Saucer
note: UFO: Paint the saucer as smooth soft grey metal with one broad highlight on top and no brushed streaks, and use fewer rivets. Light it from the upper left so the lower and far edge of the rim is slightly darker and cooler.

name: Comet
note: Meteor: Give the rock a grey stone colour with a darker lower side and craters lit from one direction. Draw the tail as a smooth pale blue trail with clean edges and no wispy streaks. Replace the wavy ribbons with soft orange sunburst rays.

name: Control Panel
note: Control Console: Paint the console body a saturated teal-blue metal with silver trim, and keep the red buttons. Replace the white slab with a plain soft floor in a slightly darker blue, with a gentle reflection.

name: Teleport Pod
note: Stasis Tube: Fill the glass with softly glowing orange liquid. Paint the cap and base ring a saturated blue with silver trim. Remove the cyan glow on the floor and add a soft dark contact shadow under the base.

name: Moon Rover
note: Moon Rover: Paint the rover body bright orange with white trim, and the tyres dark grey instead of black. Smooth the ground into soft grey-beige dust with two or three large soft craters and no scattered pebbles or small pits.

name: Moon Base
note: Moon Base: Paint the dome white with a bold teal stripe and the connecting tube bright yellow. Smooth the ground into soft blue-grey dust, slightly darker than the dome, with one or two large soft craters and no scattered pebbles or pits.

name: Zero Gravity
note: Astronaut: Make the cabin walls and seat a light neutral grey-white, and keep purple only in the small ceiling and wall lights. Shade the skin with warm brown and the yellow trousers with darker yellow-orange, not violet.

name: Flying Saucer
note: Plane (UFO): Remove the rivets on the hull. Make the rim lights soft warm yellow dots that cast a small warm glow onto the hull next to them. Light from the upper left so the right side of the saucer is slightly darker. Keep the sky and clouds.

name: Satellite
note: Satellite: Make the gold box a satin painted gold with one soft broad highlight instead of mirror chrome and white streaks, and make its right side face clearly darker. Make the solar panels soft matte blue with fewer, softer cell lines. Keep the green rays.

name: Glow Flask
note: Vending (flask): Make the glass clear pale grey-blue with white edge highlights instead of pink-tinted. Make the left side of the glass and the liquid slightly darker, with the liquid a slightly deeper yellow-green. Keep the pink background.

name: Moon Rover
note: Computer (rover): Replace the gritty grey gravel with a smooth, softly shaded dusty warm-grey ground with no pebbles or rocks. Give the white body orange trim panels. Light from the front left so the right side of the body and the inner wheel faces are clearly darker.

name: Star Map
note: Map (star chart): Make the disc face a slightly lighter medium navy blue with a soft glow across its upper half. Paint the constellation lines and stars as softer, slightly glowing marks, and drop the thin grid circles. Light the rim brightly on the upper-left edge.

name: Rocket
note: Rocket: Make the ground a smooth, softly shaded grey launch pad with no paving joints or grain. Remove the rivet row under the nose cone. Light from the upper left to match the cast shadow, so the right half of the body and the right faces of the fins are clearly darker.

name: Control Panel
note: Control Panel: Remove the porthole, the ceiling light strip and the wall rivets and seams, leaving a plain smooth purple wall slightly darker than the panel. Light from the upper left so the panel casts a soft shadow onto the wall at the lower right. Keep the panel as is.

name: Space Farm
note: Hitchhike (cow and rooster): Remove the flying saucer and its light beam and leave plain sky. Make the spacesuits soft matte white fabric with a few gentle folds and only a small sheen, keeping the orange trim. Make the grass a slightly smoother, even green with fewer tufts.

name: Saddle
note: Saddle: Replace the dashed stitching with a few soft solid seam lines at the main panel edges. Cast a soft dark shadow from the saddle onto the wooden rail just below and to its right. Keep the rest of the card as is.

name: Pig Roper
note: Pig Roper: Make the dirt ground a paler dusty grey-beige with fewer pebbles, and the fence weathered grey-brown wood. Light the pig from the upper left so its right side and belly underside are slightly darker. Keep the pig, hat, lasso and sky as they are.

name: Saddle
note: Saddle: Replace the dashed stitching with a few soft solid seam lines, and make the stirrups and buckles soft satin grey. Remove the lower fence rail and keep the blue stripes. Keep the saddle's shape and color.

name: Pig Roper
note: Pig Roper: Remove the scattered pebbles and dust specks and make the dirt a smooth, even warm tone. Make the fence and ground slightly darker so the pig is the lightest shape. Light from the upper left so the pig's right flank is slightly darker, and add a soft shadow under each hoof.

name: Cowboy Hat
note: Make the blue rays even, with only a slightly lighter centre and slightly darker corners, instead of the near-white burst behind the hat. Shade the crown dent and the brim underside slightly toward a plum-brown.

name: Sheriff Star
note: Light the star from the upper left so the lower-right arms are slightly darker. Keep bright highlights on only one or two ring balls. Darken the purple rings slightly toward the card corners.

name: Cowboy Boots
note: Change the background stripes to cool teal or sky blue. Replace the dotted turquoise stitching with a few soft solid lines. Light from the upper left so each shaft has a broad lighter face and a darker side.

name: Horseshoe
note: Paint the horseshoe as cool steel grey with bluish shadows and one crisp bright highlight along the top edge. Make the pink wall an even tone with no glow spot behind the horseshoe. Soften the dark cast shadow on the table slightly.

name: Cactus
note: Calm the bright white glow behind the cactus so the cyan rays brighten only slightly toward the centre. Slightly soften and lighten the cast shadow on the sand.

name: Saddle
note: Make the saddle smooth leather with no dashed stitching and no pore grain. Light from the upper left, with a darker right flap and the saddle's shadow cast onto the beam. Turn the pad a slightly more muted red.

name: Lasso
note: Give the rope a matte fibre finish instead of a satin sheen on every twist. Slightly deepen the brown shadows between the coils so the lasso separates from the sand.

name: Saloon
note: Paint the saloon in a saturated warm brown wood with broad smooth planks and no fine grain. Remove the fences, shrubs, rocks and scattered pebbles, and leave smooth sand. Keep the distant mesas and sky.

name: Wagon
note: Remove the sun disc and the daisies. Make the grass a slightly smoother, even green with fewer blades. Keep the wagon as is.

name: Campfire
note: Let the fire cast warm orange light onto the underside of the pot, the inner faces of the logs and the stones. Make the pot dark grey with a lit rim instead of solid black. Keep the scene otherwise.

name: Cowboy Hat
note: Cowboy Hat: Light from the upper left so the right side of the crown and the right brim curl are clearly darker. Make the felt a slightly deeper, less orange brown with a deep umber shadow under the brim. Keep the background rays.

name: Cowboy Boot
note: Cowboy Boot: Replace the dashed stitching with a few soft solid seam lines. Light the green wall evenly so its corners and the shelf edge are not darkened. Keep the boot otherwise.

name: Cactus
note: Cactus: Remove the pebbles around the base and make the sand smooth and slightly paler than the orange wall. Light from the upper left so the right arm and the right side of the trunk are slightly darker.

name: Horseshoe
note: Horseshoe: Change the pink diamond wall to a soft sky-blue diamond pattern. Remove the pebbles and make the sand smooth. Give the horseshoe a bright silver highlight along its upper-left edge.

name: Covered Wagon
note: Wagon: Remove the pebbles, the rock and the grass tufts at the bottom corners, and make the dirt road one smooth, even warm tone. Make the canvas cover a slightly whiter off-white with cool grey folds. Keep the wagon as is.

name: Windmill
note: Windmill: Paint the wheel rim and hub a dark iron red so the wheel has strong accents, and keep the blades white. Give the stone tower a clearer, darker shadow side. Make the wheat field a smooth, slightly deeper gold with only a few blade tips.

name: Mesa
note: Mesa: Remove the shrubs, grass tufts and pebbles and make the sand smooth and even. Light from the left with strong sun so the right cliff faces turn deep red-brown and the top ledges catch bright light.

name: Cactus
note: Cactus: Make the cactus a slightly deeper, natural green with a clearer dark side down the left of the trunk and arms. Turn its cast shadow on the pink floor a deeper rose-violet instead of grey. Keep the flower and backdrop.

name: Harmonica
note: Harmonica: Make the background rings slightly lighter and crisper, as evenly spaced light and dark violet bands out to the edges. Give the silver cover a faint cool blue tint in its shadows. Keep the harmonica otherwise.

name: Cowboy Boots
note: Boots: Replace the dashed stitching with a few soft solid seam lines. Make the ground a smooth, even tan with no cracks or pebbles. Light the purple stripes evenly so the corners are not darkened. Keep the boots otherwise.

name: Saloon Doors
note: Saloon Doors: Paint the wall and floor planks as smooth boards with only faint, sparse grain, in a slightly greyer weathered brown with cool blue-grey shadows. Make the view through the doorway a brighter blue sky with greener bushes. Keep the red frame and the doors.

name: Lasso
note: Lasso: Make the background a slightly deeper blue with clearer light and dark wave bands. Draw the rope twists as soft broad bands without fibre fuzz. Keep the red bandana and the loops.

name: Wagon
note: Wagon: Make the background diamonds alternate slightly more clearly between light and mid blue. Make the dirt a smooth, slightly greyer tan with no pebbles. Keep the wagon as is.

name: Horseshoe
note: Horseshoe: Make the table smooth planks with soft, faint grain and no scratches, chips or knots, in a slightly deeper, greyer brown. Make the horseshoe smooth satin metal without brush streaks, with a faint cool blue tint on its shadow side. Keep the gold nails.

name: Campfire
note: Campfire: Remove the tent and the scattered pebbles and grass tufts, and make the ground a smoother, slightly greyer brown. Make the stones cool blue-grey with violet shadows on the side away from the fire. Keep the fire, logs, kettle and trees.

name: Hat Tip
note: Pig & Farmer: Make the sky a clearer blue and add a few green bushes along the building's base. Remove the pebbles and make the dirt smooth and slightly greyer. Give the wooden porch and wall slightly cooler, plum-brown shadows. Keep the characters as is.

name: Satellite
note: Satellite: Make the gold foil body smooth with only two or three broad soft folds, and make the dish soft satin silver instead of mirror chrome. Make the orange rings slightly softer and less saturated, and give the satellite a slightly cool shadow side on its right.

name: Space Gloves
note: Space Gloves: Paint the gloves a neutral light grey-white with cool grey shadows instead of purple-tinted ones. Even out the purple background with only a gentle darkening at the corners. Keep the orange cuffs and the teal patches.

name: Toy Spaceship
note: Spaceship: Paint the hull glossy white with a red stripe along the side, and make the engine nozzles dark blue-grey metal. Replace the lime studio gradient with an even, mid-tone green background, and put a short soft shadow right under the ship. Light from the upper left so the underside and right flank are clearly darker.

name: Moon Rover
note: Rover: Make the body matte white with a few soft panel seams and an orange stripe, and keep only a thin highlight along its top edge. Make the sand a smooth, slightly deeper warm ochre. Give the rover's right side and the wheels a clear cool blue-grey shadow side.

name: Star Map
note: Star Map: Paint the chart a slightly lighter mid blue with soft lighter and darker fold panels, and remove the speckled noise. Make the compass warm brass with a small soft shine. Keep the stars and the wooden table.

name: Control Panel
note: Control Panel: Make the wall one plain, slightly deeper warm yellow surface with no rivets, vents or seams, and make the floor smooth and plain. Light from the upper left so the right side of the console and the undersides of the buttons are slightly darker. Keep the screen, dial and levers.

name: Kettle
note: Kettle: Replace the purple gradient with a violet radial sunburst of light and mid violet rays. Replace the sharp white glints with one broad soft sheen on the upper left, and make the right side of the body a slightly deeper wine red. Make the handle dark grey instead of black.

name: Whisk
note: Whisk: Replace the blurry green field and light shafts with an even green radial sunburst of light and mid green rays. Give the wires a soft silver sheen, brighter on the left wires and slightly darker on the right. Keep the orange handle.

name: Sink Tap
note: Faucet: Make the wall tiles a smooth light teal with soft, faint grout lines, and remove the yellow sunbeam streaks. Make the chrome a soft satin with one bright highlight down the left of the neck and a slightly darker right side. Keep the drops, the blue knob and the sink.

name: Toaster
note: Toaster: Replace the pink studio gradient with a pink radial sunburst of light and mid pink rays, and keep a short soft shadow under the feet. Make the body smooth satin chrome without brushed streaks, with a faint cool blue tint on its shadow side. Keep the toast and the red knob.

name: Oven Mitts
note: Oven Mitts: Replace the dashed stitching around the house patch with a soft solid seam. Make the orange fabric smooth with no fuzz, keeping the quilted diamonds as soft shallow puffs. Keep the mitts, colors and backdrop otherwise.

name: Rolling Pin
note: Rolling Pin: Replace the white marble counter with a smooth painted wooden counter in a mid tone, slightly darker than the dough. Make the wood grain on the pin fine and faint, and keep only a light dusting of flour. Keep the red handles and the purple glow.

name: Cookie Jar
note: Cookie Jar: Replace the marble with a smooth painted wooden counter in a warm mid tan, slightly darker than the jar. Give the jar a soft glaze with one small highlight on the upper left and a slightly deeper warm shadow on its right side, with a short contact shadow under it. Keep the cow face, cookies and red lid.

name: Treasure Chest
note: Treasure: Change the lid lining to a smooth, slightly darker maroon without velvet texture. Make the wood planks smooth with faint grain, with a clearly darker right side panel and cool dark-brown shadows. Keep the coins and the sand.

name: Pirate Hat
note: Pirate Hat: Paint the hat in deep navy felt, slightly lighter than now, with a soft blue-grey sheen on the crown and the top of the brim. Make the background rays alternate clearly between mid and light cyan instead of a pale wash. Keep the feather and the gold trim.

name: Pirate Ship
note: Galleon: Light from the left so each sail shades from a bright left edge to soft grey on the right, and the right side of the hull goes darker. Add a dark reflection of the hull on the water, and slightly deepen the sea toward the bottom edge. Keep the ship as is.

name: Treasure Map
note: Treasure Map: Tone the paper slightly to a warm cream. Light from the upper left so each fold has a lit face and a slightly shaded face. Add a soft, darker shadow under the sheet and the curled edges. Keep the drawing on the map.

name: Spyglass
note: Spyglass: Make the leather grip smooth dark brown with a soft sheen and no visible grain. Give the brass broader, softer reflections. Keep the lens and the green burst.

name: Ship Wheel
note: Ship's Wheel: Make the deck a few wide, smooth planks with faint grain in a slightly paler, greyer brown. Paint the wheel a slightly deeper, richer brown with cool dark-brown shadows. Keep the brass ring and the sea.

name: Anchor
note: Anchor: Change the yellow wall to a clear blue sky with soft sea haze, and remove the bright glow behind the anchor. Make the iron a slightly lighter blue-grey with a darker shadow side on the right. Make the deck a few wide, smooth planks with faint grain in a slightly paler, greyer brown.
